onboarding.step1_body: Read, listen and reflect on the Quran — plus prayer times, athkar and a daily hadith, all in one app.
onboarding.step2_body: Swipe between real Mushaf pages. Tap anywhere to show or hide the menu, and hold an ayah to see its translation and tafsir.
onboarding.step3_body: Tap the play button on any page, or pick from 7 reciters in the top bar.
onboarding.step4_body: Accurate prayer times for your location, plus a live compass pointing toward the Qiblah.
onboarding.step5_body: Morning and evening athkar, a daily hadith and helpful reminders — all customizable from Settings.
